Game Overview

At its heart, Moto Maniac 2 is a bike game about race through a perilous, under-construction bridge at night in Moto Maniac 2. Test your skills by navigating tricky obstacles with just your bike and a trusty drone to light the way. Balance, speed, and adaptability are your best allies in making it safely to the finish line.
